The '''Sartoy weapons plant''' was a [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing]] base<ref name="RAS2" /> that was located in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sartoy system/Legends|Sartoy system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its defenses consisted of two [[Company/Legends|companies]] of [[Militia/Legends|militia]] and several [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] in a beat-up condition.<ref name="RAS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sartoy weapons plant was first mentioned in [[Paul Murphy]]'s [[1990]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
